propositions: Ticking acceptance-criteria checkboxes does not invalidate a plan-review attestation because checkbox state is normalized out before hashing via `_normalize_checkbox_state`.
Staleness messages name a fixed fictional list (description/AC/file_impact/children) rather than identifying which actual component changed, causing diagnostic confusion.
The material basis is a composite sha256 over exactly four keys (ticket_id, description, file_impact, children) plus file_impact_scope when scope is 'none', but AC is not a basis component.
Pre-330c attestations hashed raw descriptions without normalization, so post-normalization tickets may fail grandfather matching despite unchanged material, producing spurious staleness reports.

Per-component fingerprints signed into the manifest as additive `material-part:` lines enable drift attribution without replaying the event store, which is infeasible because children are derived from other tickets' state at read time.

Attestation refusal messages across six surfaces (stale-material, stale-reopened, unsigned, generation, resign, completion) must name the specific changed components and provide actionable remedies rather than generic text.
